ops.en: The 4:1 formula re-run in exile: knew / conceived / bore. The WIFE HAS NO SOURCE — no birth, no building, no naming precedes her [OPEN: the letter's most famous silent presence; the chain's dossiers queue; nothing invented]. The child: Chanokh — a name the letter will use again in the OTHER line (5:18: same lemma) for the man who walks with God.

THE FIRST HUMAN WORLD INSTALL — every created entity so far was made by God; the corpus's first human-built thing is a CITY, built by the man sentenced to WANDER (the letter's structural irony: na va-nad -> boneh ir). And the verb is a PARTICIPLE (TIR-031): 'he WAS BUILDING' — a standing state, not a completed act: the letter never finishes the city. ir's corpus career from here: tokens 1-2 this v…

The naming verb (va-yiqra — day 1's instrument, the registry's formula) is spent on the CITY, not the child: the boy's own naming is never narrated. The registry takes a PLACE for the first time — and the name points AWAY from the builder: ke-shem BENO, 'after the name of his SON.' The wanderer's monument bears the next generation's name.

A MOTIVE ASSIGNED TO THE BUILD [claim G13-09]. Naming the city after a son is read as the wicked man's bid for a name that endures - 'their inward thought is that their houses shall continue forever' - answered by the ruling that in the end their houses become their graves. [folded shape: kept record]

The chain opens PASSIVE and agentless (TIR-032): 'was born TO Enoch' — no mother is named in the entire chain (the wives surface only when Lamech takes two). The fastest genealogical verse yet: four generations in sixteen words.

Active link one — and the letter spells the son's name TWO WAYS INSIDE THIS ONE VERSE: Mechuyael (with vav) at birth, Mechiyael (with double yod) as father, six words later [letter fact, DB-verified; held, not fixed — nothing invented to explain it].

Active link two. The two lines will share this name-shape: Metushael (lemma 4967) here, Metushelach (lemma 4968 — ADJACENT dictionary entries) in Seth's line — beside Chanokh = Chanokh and Lemekh = Lemekh (SAME lemmas) and Qayin/Qenan, Irad/Yered: two genealogies drawing on one name-pool [OPEN — the letter offers no comment].

Active link three, arriving at LAMECH — the SEVENTH from Adam in this line (Adam, Kayin, Chanokh, Irad, Mechuyael, Metushael, Lemekh): the seventh man will speak in sevens (4:24). In the other line the seventh from Adam is the Chanokh who walks with God (5:24) — the same slot, the two lines' sharpest contrast.

THE GENEALOGY IS READ AS A RUNNING JUDGMENT [claim G13-10]. The line-names are parsed as decree-verbs spoken against the line itself: Irad, 'I will expel them'; Mechuyael, 'I will erase them'; Metushael, 'I will uproot them'; and of Lemekh, 'what have I to do with Lemekh'. What the machine records as descent the chain reads as a sentence-ledger. The two-wives institution of the era is described be…

ops.en: The wives' names are REPORTED, not conferred: nominal clauses (shem... shem...), NO naming verb — so no NAME operator (letter-honest: the registry's formula is va-yiqra, and it does not appear). Held as standing facts. These are the corpus's first named living women after Chavah — and they are named to be commanded (4:23).
The crafts half-verses begin. Yaval — the first of the three founder-brothers.

THE OFFICE FORMULA: AVI ('father-of' — the father-word's token 2, after 2:24) + a standing participle (yoshev, TIR-031): 'father of tent-dweller and herds' — fatherhood extended past biology into FOUNDING: the corpus's first craft-office. First tokens: OHEL ('tent' — the dwelling the Tabernacle chapters will inherit) and MIKNEH ('herds' — the qanah root of KAYIN'S OWN NAME-ETYMOLOGY: 4:1 kaniti ->…

Yuval enters BY NAME ONLY — no birth verb anywhere (the letter's economy: 'and his brother's name was...'). The office formula repeats EXACTLY — the 4:20 and 4:21 trees are SHAPE-IDENTICAL (DB tree fact: the accents isolate avi on its own branch in both — the formula has become a template). The office: ALL who handle (tofes, participle TIR-031) KINOR ('harp' — first token; token 2 is Laban's send-…

GAM-HI ('she ALSO') — the also-thread's second station (4:4 Abel ALSO brought; here; 4:26 Seth ALSO fathered) — written with the he-written/she-read spelling (its third token in our spans: 3:12, 3:20, 4:22 — letter fact, held). The child carries the ancestor's name INSIDE his own: Tuval-KAYIN — the only compound name in either line.

THE FORMULA BREAKS: no avi — Tuval-Kayin is LOTESH ('hammerer', direct participle TIR-031) of every choresh ('craftsman') of NECHOSHET and BARZEL: bronze and iron, both first tokens — bronze's token 2 is the TABERNACLE donation list (Exod 25:3); iron's token 2 is skies-like-iron (Lev 26:19, a curse text). The smith gets no father-title (Onkelos GRANTS him the guild-master title anyway — the asymme…

THE FIRST METALLURGY OPERATOR READ AS AN INDUSTRY'S ORIGIN [claim G13-11]. The craft-founders are read darkly - holdings as provocation, instruments as serving idols - and the smith 'SEASONED Cain's transgression: Cain killed without an instrument; this one forges every cutting edge.' The install joins back to the previous block's undecided weapon. [folded shape: cross-corpus link]

The genealogy breaks into VERSE: the tree carves four parallel cola (summons-pair, boast-pair) — prose accents bending around a poem. The first human poem since 2:23 — and where the man's poem greeted a wife, this one is addressed AT two wives, by name.

THE CORPUS'S FIRST HUMAN-ISSUED IMPERATIVES (TIR-027): every imperative before this verse is divine blessing (1:22, 1:28); the mood's first human use is a man commanding his wives to hear a kill-boast — and they are the first feminine-plural commands (shemaan / haazenah, the hear/give-ear pair the prophets will inherit). Rebbi grades it and FAILS it: 'a flawed a-fortiori, an a-fortiori of darkness - from whom would He ever collect His note?'. Yet the Jerusalem Talmud cites this very verse as the exhibit a-fortiori one may not deny, its own edit…
The camera returns to Eden's pair: the 4:1 know-formula with OD ('again') — the narrative resumes over the dead son's gap. The wife goes unnamed here (ishto — Chavah's name last appeared at 4:1).
The MOTHER names again (va-tiqra — as at 4:1; the naming alternates: mother, mother, father-for-a-city, mother, and 4:26's father): the corpus's second birth-etymology, hers again.

The etymology's verb is 3:15's: SHAT ('has SET') — the shit root's ONLY other token in Gen 1-10 is ASHIT ('I will SET' — the enmity, gen_11's PATTERN): the root that set the war between seeds now sets a replacement seed — and ZERA ('seed') is that verse's own contested word, here 'ANOTHER seed' with TACHAT ('in place of'): replacement semantics entering the corpus over Abel's name. The FATHER names (va-yiqra, masculine — the alternation's last turn), and the name is the corpus's THIRD WORD FOR 'MAN': adam (the species, from the ground), ish (the male, from the rib-poem), now ENOSH — the frail one (the poets' word for man-as-mortal): the line that will carry the Name names its child 'mortal.'
